name: Ice Wall
description: A wall with HP equal to 25% of your max HP absorbs melee hits aimed at the party’s front row until it breaks or 2 turns pass; an enemy that strikes it is Chilled 1 turn.

effects.note: a wall with HP = percent% of the caster’s max HP absorbs melee hits aimed at the party’s front row for `duration` turns or until broken; a melee attacker that strikes it gets `status` 1
